node.statement: Route F F3 retract defect: let K >= 1 be a dimension-independent constant, n,k >= 1, A: l_inf^k -> l_inf^n and M: l_inf^n -> l_inf^k positive unital maps, Q: l_inf^n -> l_inf^n row-stochastic, and eta >= 0 with 3K*eta < 1; if ||Q - AM||_{inf->inf} <= K*eta, ||QA - A||_{inf->inf} <= 2K*eta, and ||Ax||_inf >= (1-3K*eta)*||x||_inf for every x in l_inf^k, then ||MA - I_k||_{inf->inf} <= 3K*eta/(1-3K*eta).
